## Natural history notes

A small orange-and-black butterfly characterized by bright orange wings with dark scalloped markings, pale crescent-shaped spots, and a checkered pattern along the wing edges. In Florida, it is found in open sunny habitats such as fields, prairies, roadsides, gardens, pine flatwoods, and disturbed areas where asters and other low flowering plants are present. Adults feed on nectar from a variety of wildflowers, while the caterpillars feed mainly on asters and related plants, often using low vegetation as both food and shelter.
